product_metadata.title: KINGSBULL HOME Bread Pan Loaf Pan Ceramic Bread Pans for Baking Porcelain Baking Pans Nonstick Meatloaf Pan
features: 【HEALTHY MATERIALS】 The Bread Pan is made of durable porcelain, a type of premium ceramic, resists staining, odors, chipping and cracking.

【CONVENIENT CLEANING】Whether you want to clean the pie dish by hand or with your dishwasher, it won't matter because the smooth porcelain texture makes cleanup a breeze. and It is suitable for microwave, freezer and oven.
【BEAUTIFUL PATTERN】 The Loaf Pan features Hand-painted pattern and bright color for easy daily use. Classical and remarkable display can be a charming decoration in your table and kitchen.

【PERFECT SIZE】 The Baking Pans measures 9.8”long, 5.5”wide and 3.2”deep. It is not only good for baking Bread Loaf, Pound Cakes, Rolls, Brownies but also ideal for making Meatloaf, Side Dishes, Lasagna and more.

【MULTIFUNCTIONAL USE】 The Loaf Pan is MICROWAVE SAFE (400 ℉/205 ℃), OVEN SAFE, FREEZER SAFE, DISHWASHER SAFE. It can be transited directly from a freezer to a oven, to serve your food on the table without changing containers.
